issues.observed: Attacking -> [*] via Attack_Finished_Decrease_UAV_swarm_count with effect R45RouteToken = 14
issues.reason: NL4 requires a variable delta effect decreasing UAV count after attack completion; closed model transition line 55 carries effect R45RouteToken = 14 and no variable delta on number of UAVs.
issues.requirement_quote: After completing the attack, the number of UAVs in the swarm decreases accordingly.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Event name contains Decrease UAV swarm count, suggesting intent is encoded in event naming
issues.title: Attack completion transition lacks UAV count decrease effect

issues.basis: NL2 derived containment contract; exact_source_inventory states SearchMission parent null, SearchMission.Region1 parent SearchMission, SearchMission.Region1.Region2 parent SearchMission.Region1, SearchMission.Region1.Region2.Region3 parent SearchMission.Region1.Region2; inspection_equivalent_facts hierarchy
issues.expected: UAV swarm / SearchMission contains three distinct state areas as direct members for target search
issues.observed: SearchMission contains Region1 only; Region2 and Region3 are nested composites under Region1, and Search is the operating leaf
issues.reason: Derived containment contract expects UAV swarm to own three state areas; source inventory shows Region1 as direct child of SearchMission with Region2/Region3 nested deeper, so scope of three areas is not direct containment
issues.requirement_quote: Before the mission is completed, the UAV swarm continuously performs target search tasks, during which it operates within three different state areas.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Nested Region1/Region2/Region3 provide three distinct areas reachable during search, albeit via nesting not direct containment
issues.title: Three state areas not contained as direct children of UAV swarm

issues.basis: NL-CONTRACT-NL4-ENDPOINT-1, exact_source_inventory.states, exact_source_inventory.transitions tr_0012, inspection_equivalent_facts.transitions transition:line:59, event_consumers Task_Assignment_Received
issues.expected: Flight scope transitions to attack state on Task Assignment Received
issues.observed: Closed model realises SearchMission -> AttackState guarded by R45RouteToken==12; Task_Assignment_Received is consumed inside Search/Region states setting the token
issues.reason: PlantUML source contains no Flight state; the source transition targets AttackState composite and the closed model implements the move via token guard rather than a direct trigger from a Flight source
issues.requirement_quote: During flight, if task assignment information is received, it enters the attack state.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: AttackState encloses Attacking and is reachable after the token, matching the intended attack behaviour
issues.title: Task assignment transition source is SearchMission not Flight and target is AttackState composite

issues.expected: Completing attack decreases number of UAVs variable
issues.observed: Attacking -> [*] transition triggers Attack_Finished_Decrease_UAV_swarm_count with effect R45RouteToken = 14; no UAV count variable update is present
issues.reason: The NL requires a variable decrease effect; the closed model only updates route token and has no UAV count variable or delta
issues.requirement_quote: After completing the attack, the number of UAVs in the swarm decreases accordingly.
